notes:
Inbound from product-led signup (converted from free trial). Small B2B SaaS — building embeddable in-app chat for mid-market SaaS customers. Primary ask: low-latency streaming for multi-turn support flows.

- Demo run 2026-03-05 (30m): Maya + Liam. Showed streaming + JS SDK. CTO (R. Patel) cares about p95 <300ms for 1-2 concurrent users per customer instance.
- Currently using a lightweight LLM proxy (self-hosted) in POC; wants to move to hosted API to avoid infra ops.
- Tech stack: React (web), React Native for mobile embed, Node.js backend for routing and auth.
- Key quote from CTO: "We need streaming that looks instantaneous — can't tolerate chunk delays. Also want predictable per-customer cost."
- Asked about prefix caching and websocket-based streaming — interested in Redwood's streaming SDK and SDK examples repo.
- Security: wants SSO (SAML) for admin console and audit logs for first 12 months. Not air-gapped; OK with public cloud but needs data retention controls.
- Cost sensitivity: early-stage, trying to keep run-rate <$2k/month during POC; will expand if pricing predictable.
- Timeline: POC through March, production beta targeted late Q2.
- Action items: provide sample p95 benchmarks for comparable customers, estimate token cost for 3M tokens/month projection, confirm SAML setup guide, send billing-activation steps for self-serve accounts.

use_case_summary: Embedding a low-latency, streaming chat assistant inside customer-facing SaaS apps. Multi-tenant model: each customer sees a pooled hosted model but separate session state. Requirements: streaming websocket or SSE, p95 <300ms for generation start, predictable per-token billing, basic admin SSO + audit logs.
notes_short: SMB inbound — product-led, latency-first, wants hosted API streaming. POC budget constrained, timeline to beta end of Q2.
sales_notes: Good fit for Hosted API trial -> mid-market expansion. Upsell path: Dedicated when multi-tenant scale grows. Watch for pricing sensitivity; provide clear batching/caching knobs to reduce unit cost.
